description:
What do verified holders think about a token? Returns the bull/bear summary
    and the latest (or top) theses: short posts that only people holding the token
    in a CabalSpy ID verified wallet can write, each with the author's live
    position (holding or sold, invested, PnL). Use for "What do holders say about
    $BONK?" or "Is sentiment on this token bullish?".

    Needs your own CabalSpy API key with a CabalSpy ID instance (no demo).
    Example: blockchain='solana', mint='DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263'.
    Page with the returned next_cursor.

blockchain.description: Blockchain. One of: solana, bnb, base, eth, rh. solana has kol, smart and whale wallets; bnb, base, eth and rh have kol and smart. rh is Robinhood Chain, an Ethereum L2.
blockchain.title: Blockchain

cursor.description: Pagination cursor taken from the previous response. Leave empty for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

instance.description: Your CabalSpy ID instance (its client_id, e.g. 'csid_1a2b…'). Only needed when your account has several instances. Leave empty otherwise.
instance.title: Instance

limit.description: How many theses to return (1-25, default 10).
limit.title: Limit

mint.description: Token address: the mint on Solana, the contract address on the EVM chains.
mint.title: Mint

scope.description: 'global' (default): theses posted on every platform that uses CabalSpy ID. 'instance': only theses written on your own CabalSpy ID instance.
scope.title: Scope

stance.description: Only bullish ('bull') or bearish ('bear') theses. Leave empty for all, including neutral ones.
stance.title: Stance

name: csid_token_theses
